Asylum is a human right — and the mass deportation of Haitians, especially Haitian children, is inhumane.

I’m joining @RepCori, @SenBooker, and 100+ colleagues in urging the Biden Administration to ensure this horrific treatment never happens again. #EndTitle42. https://t.co/OybwXKMqdT

The @January6thCmte hearings aren’t just an exercise in history. Domestic  violent extremism is growing in the US.

Despite record profits during COVID, rail companies have nickel & dimed workers over just 7 days of paid sick leave.

Our rail workers deserve good wages, fair treatment, & the dignity of taking paid sick leave if necessary.

I voted in support of this deal & our workers.

Through Director McNerney’s work, the US can continue to stand as an example to our allies for the proper treatment, transparency, and care of civilians in conflict areas.

I started the day doing physical training with the @3rdSFgroup. They wouldn’t give me the T-shirt until after I survived the workout. (I got the T-shirt.) [photos cleared by US Army] 2/5 https://t.co/l3Z6DKe9vx
Later, I joined my fellow Rangers (I was an Army Ranger in Afghanistan) for an urban combat exercise. Can confirm clearing buildings is a perishable skill… 3/5 https://t.co/eNZxCrOy43

Young Coloradans need to know there’s somewhere to turn when times get tough.

Today I delivered $1.5M in #CO06 funding for @CCSDK12’s new first-of-its-kind school district operated, mental health day treatment center that supports Colorado’s students. https://t.co/nwnQXkd9Ts

1 in 5 Americans suffer from a mental health illness. More than half don’t receive treatment.

This #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth, we recommit to normalizing support and breaking the silence. Here are resources if you or someone you care about needs help: https://t.co/IEhuWWaWRH https://t.co/KXQ7oMVBFT

Wishing you strength and a successful treatment, @SteveScalise.
https://t.co/wh9UrGXG5N.

Toured Traverse Academy, the nation’s first-of-its-kind school district mental health treatment facility in @CCSDK12.

Grateful to have secured $1.5M to help build Traverse Academy and meet our students’ mental health needs in #CO06. https://t.co/S9Nsn4O0Mz

Rosalynn Carter served with kindness and compassion and championed mental wellness when stigma made most fear seeking help.

My heart is with her inseparable partner of over 75 years, President Carter, and the entire Carter family as they grieve her loss.

I've had the pleasure of working alongside @JacksonLeeTX18 who has always been an unstoppable advocate for her constituents.

My heart goes out to her and her family in light of this cancer diagnosis. 

I'm keeping you all in my thoughts and hoping for a speedy recovery.

When I was in the Army, a piece of shrapnel got lodged in my body armor during a training exercise in Afghanistan.

I keep that shrapnel in my office now as a reminder that decisions made in Washington are not abstract; they have real-life consequences. https://t.co/gZgfJPPfMx

We need to stop listening to the threats from Vladimir Putin and the Kremlin.

They lie, distort, and feed Americans a steady diet of misinformation to hurt US interests.

Allowing Ukraine to use weapons to fully defend their people and infrastructure against Russian attacks is the right move and in the best interest of US national security.

The Senate should reject her nomination.

From childcare to health and nutrition services, Head Start helps thousands of kids across Colorado reach their full potential.

Gutting this program would hurt working families.

President Trump should not cut or eliminate Head Start. https://t.co/RDIWKxi6YF

A letter from one of my constituents:

“There is simply no way we would have been able to afford the lifesaving care that our child received because of Medicaid.”

Republican Medicaid cuts are cruel and shameful. https://t.co/AHPVRyXDo1

Answering calls from constituents concerned about Republican cuts to Medicaid & food assistance.

To the hundreds of Coloradans calling my office –– I’m fighting to stop this disastrous bill. https://t.co/CrnV7UYwr0

Trump’s Big Ugly Bill means over $3 TRILLION added to the national debt.

That would be one of the largest increases to the debt.

Republicans just want to cut Medicaid to give tax breaks for billionaires.

My constituents are calling my office scared. 

They don’t know if they will be able to survive these Republican Medicaid cuts.

It’s heartbreaking & cruel. https://t.co/UvDfT8V80t

Trump’s cuts to Medicaid will make health care more expensive for everyone else.

Kicking millions of people off of their health care will hurt rural hospitals & drive up costs.

My constituents are calling me in tears. They’re scared of Trump’s cuts to Medicaid.

They don’t know where they’ll get their health care. Or how they’ll pay for their medicine.

The Republican cuts are devastating and real. https://t.co/oDAOlASPDD
